finding: Official OS Building schema defines Building as a single building footprint; osid is the primary feature identifier; buildinguse is mandatory and describes Building use; the UPRN Reference cross-reference maps an address UPRN to buildingid.
exact_reason: This official schema window defines the identifier/linkage mechanism and evidenced Building Use field but contains no concrete Building feature record with Polygon coordinates that is bound to the project's exact canonical_parcel_id. Exact project canonical identity plus concrete footprint geometry therefore remain missing; accepted_count stays zero.
